rubrics.intent_basis: Action functions are removed from invalidFunctions before i18n reconciliation in the production sequence.
rubrics.baseline_defect: The i18n loop retains action-variant eligibility, a route-override search, and a special ignored-function reason after the earlier action cleanup has retired those entries.
rubrics.criterion: Remove the unreachable action-specific reconciliation from the locale loop while retaining the live locale alternative and override behavior.
rubrics.acceptance: For collected invalid functions, the i18n path no longer carries action-specific candidate selection or action-only state, and ordinary locale candidates still use their valid edge alternative. Direct deletion and simplification are sufficient. Existing supporting helpers may remain when they have live work, or be removed/inlined with their live semantics preserved; their names and return objects are not mandatory. Equivalent functions, policy data, composition or a redesigned flow qualify; no prescribed helper, class, file, return object or one-component-per-item design is required. One coherent redesign may satisfy multiple independent items.
insufficient_repairs: Leaving the same unreachable alternative under a renamed helper or guard is insufficient; deleting a shared live operation is also insufficient. An equivalent redesign preserving supported pipeline behavior qualifies.
